g.text: Figure 3a State Machine — Engagement Lifecycle (driven by A1 Orchestrator)
Archived stays reactive (production may add to the file);
Declined and Withdrawn are the final states (M-14).
A material report revision after EQR invalidates
the EQR record and returns to EQR_Check.
/ apply d.edits, version +1 on edited RiskItems
stop at next safe point, keep Judgments
no open dispute, no confirmation pending]
/ sign, reportDate = today, RPT-06 hashes + lock
affected procedures to the new report date;
signed version stays locked, notify recipients
Yellow = human gate (interrupt). Every transition leaving a gate is
triggered by decisionSubmitted(d) via DecisionSubmit; guards on d shown.
d = GateDecision.decision in {approve, reject, insufficient_info}, one enum for all gates:
ACC-01 approve = accept engagement; ACC-08 approve = terms and appointment confirmed;
PLN-15 and GATE-R approve = plan / risk revision approved;
FIN-01 and FIN-02 = one decision each; RPT-01 approve = sign.
r = ReviewRecord.decision on a ReviewTask (queue item, not a gate).
d.disposition = per-gate payload validated by A1 (gate x disposition matrix):
ACC-10 continue / modify_opinion / withdraw; GATE-R withdraw (handled as the ACC-10 exit);
PLN-18 approve = scope limitation accepted. Withdrawal is possible from P1 to P4 and GATE-R;
every entry into Withdrawn seals the workpapers (hashes, read-only, 18.5).
Pending StatutoryReport records (Figure 3b) block Gate_RPT01 (M-12) and survive Withdrawn.
insufficient_info keeps a gate open and re-presents (18.4 gate_route);
ACC-01 is the exception and returns to BackgroundCheck.
Blue = waiting for external input or re-execution
